Disambiguate provider-sibling worker route health in healthz
description: Healthz collapses route-health entries by canonical_model_id, so provider siblings like zai::glm-5.1 and ollama-pro::glm-5.1 overwrite each other in the reported routes map. This can make worker health look inconsistent with the live proxy log when one sibling is saturated and another is healthy. Add provider-specific route-health reporting or another non-colliding key so healthz reflects actual per-route state.

Add Ollama reasoning-budget request shaping
description: Ollama Cloud models exposed through the new ollama-pro provider can return a success-shaped chat completion with empty visible content when callers send a small max_tokens budget. Example: gpt-oss:120b via alias gpt-oss-120b-ollama-pro returned finish_reason=length, message.reasoning present, and message.content='' at max_tokens=32, while max_tokens=128 returned 'OK'. Add a provider-aware mitigation or generic empty-content reasoning retry/floor so low-budget requests do not look successful while yielding no visible answer.
